definitions: To subject someone to unwanted sexual advances, requests for sexual favors, and other verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature.
To create an intimidating, hostile, or offensive working or learning environment through sexual conduct.
examples: He was accused of sexually harassing his colleagues.
The company has a strict policy against sexually harassing employees.
She reported that her boss would sexually harass her with inappropriate comments.
pastTenses: sexually harassed (simple past), sexually harassed (past perfect)
